districts.name: Paradise
districts.subtitle: District 1 · Near the Japanese islands
districts.description: An Icelorian and Dwarven homeland renowned for rare minerals and ores. The notes describe its destruction in Ioward Icelander’s past and a later effort by Kaden and his allies to reclaim and cleanse it.

districts.name: Aliorvia
districts.subtitle: District 2 · France
districts.description: The sacred home of the Elven nation, its queen, and a wise supreme council. The notes associate Lucy Terner’s future with an Elven succession, while the series glossary establishes Aliorvia’s mainland location.

districts.name: Tris Bourna
districts.subtitle: District 3 · Central volcano · Mystical Island
districts.description: Pyrus Bourn’s stronghold lies beneath the volcanic remnants of the island’s largest mountain. His Fire Increaser Co. operates here, with an armory at the snowcaps. The concealed forest entrance is described between Districts 7 and 13.

districts.name: Silwastra
districts.subtitle: District 4 · Mystical Island
districts.description: A home of Satyrs and Nymphs on the Mystical Island. Its position within this illustrated island is approximate; the glossary does not establish precise boundaries.

districts.name: Atalantia
districts.subtitle: District 5 · Waters surrounding Mystical Island
districts.description: The Aquia kingdom lies beneath the waters along the island. Water Spirits, Naiads, and Nereids live here. Avery travels below the sea with Atlas and Alteria in The Messengers’ Return, discovering his own ability to breathe underwater.

districts.name: Magnivicious United Empire
districts.subtitle: District 6 · Russia
districts.description: Home of the strong martial Magnivirigentis clans. The notes connect District 6 and Imperium with the northern military buildup and later inter-district tensions.

districts.name: Lux Urbis
districts.subtitle: District 7 · Mystical Island · Arctic region
districts.description: The first established district and central haven of the Mystical Beings. The most technologically advanced district contains Regnum Academy, IT’s operations, and the Mystical Council. Its city walls and protective dome stand apart from the island-wide mist barrier.

districts.name: Longjing
districts.subtitle: District 8 · China
districts.description: A homeland connected with the mythical dragons of the distant past and their descendants. The glossary describes its present inhabitants as elemental species, including Metalors, Herbovirs, and other Elementors.

districts.name: District 9
districts.subtitle: District 9 · Australia
districts.description: A sheltered home for beast-like demihumans. The series glossary includes Satyrs, bird-like demihumans, and Merpeople among its inhabitants, but does not give this district a proper name.

districts.name: Animusteria
districts.subtitle: District 10 · Africa
districts.description: Magic-rich natural plains inhabited by beast-like predator species, with large undeveloped areas used for magical research. The glossary describes tribal factions and rotating sovereignty responsible for shared rules and diplomacy.

districts.name: Trinigear
districts.subtitle: District 11 · Canada
districts.description: A Runigist homeland of craftsmanship, factories, shops, and locomotive machinery. Its technology combines organic and metal innovation, extending the magical world’s industry beyond IT and the Mystical Island.

districts.name: Luminia
districts.subtitle: District 12 · Italy
districts.description: A kingdom ruled by the Magni Luminis and the Luces royal line. Founded by Zenith Luces, it is a home for demihumans, especially winged species, and has numerous trading ports. Lux speaks of her nation’s history and position in The Messengers’ Return.

details.Known for: Luces royal line · winged demihumans · ports

districts.name: Noxdeus Axiom
districts.subtitle: District 13 · Mystical Island
districts.description: Also known as the District of Doom: a populous, militaristic district with entertainment, advanced technology, and hidden dealings. Its black market becomes important in the notes’ continuation of the I.T.E.R. crisis.

landmarks.name: Mystical Island
landmarks.subtitle: Hidden Arctic haven
landmarks.description: A concealed island between Greenland and Iceland. The Sustination Orb maintains a mist barrier that makes non-Mystical travelers pass through without discovering the island, while regulating the climate within. The central mountain and surrounding forest, beaches, harbor, and districts are described in Beginning.

landmarks.name: New York
landmarks.subtitle: Mainland beginnings
landmarks.description: Avery’s early home and the mainland setting for OSNYC, ATLAS, IT Tower, and the Sky House in Central Park’s Weeping Woods. Captain Levi’s cargo route brings Avery, Ted, and River from New York to the hidden island.

details.Sites: OSNYC · ATLAS · Sky House · IT Tower

landmarks.name: Regnum Academy
landmarks.subtitle: Lux Urbis · District 7
landmarks.description: Avery, Ted, River, and Jane share Quad 44 at Regnum. The academy trains Mystical Beings, organizes cohorts, and hosts the lights celebration, flag competition, and Winter’s Dance.

landmarks.name: IT Tower
landmarks.subtitle: Lux Urbis · District 7
landmarks.description: IT is the technological organization at the center of Kaden’s projects and the I.T.E.R. crisis. Its tower houses the agency’s work, research, and management; Avery joins as an intern.

landmarks.name: Aquia Estate
landmarks.subtitle: Lux Urbis · District 7
landmarks.description: The estate provides a base for Tempest Aquia and the setting for Avery’s early training encounter with Alteria. It is distinct from the Aquia family’s underwater kingdom in District 5.

landmarks.name: Island Harbor
landmarks.subtitle: Arrival from the mainland
landmarks.description: A modern harbor of ships, repair shops, rentals, hotels, and busy trade. Avery first sees the island’s central mountain from here before Elmor guides the group toward Regnum Academy.

details.Story: Beginning · The Light of the City

landmarks.name: Concealed Lair Entrance
landmarks.subtitle: Forest between Districts 7 and 13
landmarks.description: The entrance to Pyrus Bourn’s lair is hidden in the forest between Lux Urbis and Noxdeus Axiom. The stronghold itself extends beneath the central volcanic mountain.

landmarks.name: District 13 Black Market
landmarks.subtitle: Noxdeus Axiom · District 13
landmarks.description: The notes send Kaden’s fugitive group into the district’s nighttime bazaar to trace the network behind copied I.T.E.R. machines. This location belongs to the outlined continuation of the I.T.E.R. crisis.
